description: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three distinct benchmarks: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0 to 70 with increments of 10, while the horizontal axis lists the three benchmark names. For each benchmark, two bars are displayed side-by-side: a blue bar representing MMAU and a purple bar representing MMAR. In the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct benchmark, MMAU achieves an accuracy of approximately 48%, while MMAR achieves about 30%. In the Audio-Reasoner benchmark, MMAU reaches an accuracy of around 61%, and MMAR reaches approximately 36%. For the Qwen-2.5-Omni benchmark, MMAU achieves an accuracy of about 65%, and MMAR achieves around 56%. Across all three benchmarks, MMAU consistently outperforms MMAR, with the largest gap in accuracy observed in the Qwen2-Audio-Instruct benchmark.
